file: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-SVC-S9 rwb-partner (Partner)/RWB S9 E7014 APP Issue a notice on a missed target v1.md
old: None. The service owns the topic `rwb.partner.events.v1` and its event set carries EV-20 `InstructionIssued` (`instructionId`, `partnerId`, `type`, `dueOn`, consumed by the partner portal) and EV-21 `PartnerResultSubmitted` (`instructionId`, `result`, `documents`), and both belong to the instruction and result steps of the service (Event and Messaging Design v4; TSD S9 T5.3). A notice is a Communications fact: rwb-comms publishes `NoticeGenerated` (EV-13) and `NoticeDispatched` (EV-14), and this step only requests the notice and records the panel change. It therefore declares no event, no producer group and no outbox row, and a build that publishes EV-20 or an event of its own here fails the absence test. The topic carries the retry and `.dlt` topics of the platform (DP-14), and the outbox and inbox library that relays an event is the DP-09 dependency the plan does not carry (GAP-3127; ASM-5454).
